title: Capacity wording is unclear
ui_container_and_type: Header banner; span.agents-count inside span#agents-capacity; capacity/status text
requested_outcome: Make the header explain an actionable capacity fact in plain language, or omit a count with no useful meaning.
evidence_and_limits: Inherited source wording; no live liveness or capacity diagnosis. pauseSignals formats the same agents_running value in Agents and Slots and falls back to Not reported for agents_cap.
suggested_owner: Deck UI wording + producer field meaning

title: Progress bars do not line up
ui_container_and_type: Request/task metadata progress bar; annotated element is a span. The recorded positional selector does not identify which bar kind.
requested_outcome: Align equivalent bars consistently and give them consistent lengths within the same card type.
evidence_and_limits: Observed user layout feedback. There are two distinct bars: completed-task ratio (.request-bar, 40px) and declared-step progress (.prog-bar; task-row width 64px). Do not silently conflate the metrics; the payload alone cannot disambiguate the selected bar.
suggested_owner: Deck layout; exact bar subtype needs visual confirmation

title: Spend labels do not share a position
ui_container_and_type: Request header metadata; span.usage-line cost/token summary
requested_outcome: Keep spend summaries aligned across comparable cards, regardless of optional progress text and label length.
evidence_and_limits: Source uses a wrapping flex metadata row; this is a source fact, not a proven sole cause of the reported alignment. The reviewed cost/token values also use the frozen numeric supplement.

title: Paused card appears under In progress
ui_container_and_type: In progress request group; Example: Wait briefly for a local check; div.request-head and its Paused state label
semantic_locator: #state-column-now .request-row:has(.request-name) > .request-head; identify title Example: Wait briefly for a local check
requested_outcome: A paused card should not visually contradict the section label.
evidence_and_limits: Snapshot-only placement: the offline bundler deliberately overrides requestState for raw.offline_example so all three requested examples remain in In progress. The source requestState otherwise routes paused tasks to Paused. Do not report this example as a reproduced live state-routing defect.
suggested_owner: Snapshot harness; preserve separate product state-consistency feedback

title: Repeated 0 of 1 task done label is unhelpful
ui_container_and_type: Request metadata; span.request-count in span.request-progress; task-completion counter
requested_outcome: Explain or simplify the completed-task count and its relationship to active tasks; avoid repetitive labels that add no value.
evidence_and_limits: The label counts completed tasks out of request members, not simultaneous running workers or declared steps. Frozen request membership has 136 one-task requests, 8 two-task, 2 four-task and 1 fourteen-task request. All examples were cloned as one-task requests, amplifying the repetition. The capability to have more than one task is established; usefulness remains the captain’s UX concern.

title: In-progress indicator is poor and inconsistent; proposal requested
ui_container_and_type: Just-started example request metadata; div.prog.request-stage with progress/freshness text and possible ::before indicator
semantic_locator: #state-column-now .request-row .request-stage; title Example: Inspect device folder listing
requested_outcome: Prepare a Lavish proposal for a clearer, consistent running/loading indicator, including progress-known and no-progress cases.
evidence_and_limits: Explicit follow-up deliverable requested by captain; this intake does not fulfill that proposal. Source indicator ::before is conditional on active activity and non-current freshness; progress freshness also chooses measured/unmeasured labels. Snapshot examples supply synthetic freshness, and animations default off in the clone until toggled. No live animation defect is proven from this round.
suggested_owner: Deck design proposal; Firstmate to route requested Lavish follow-up

title: Why are requests with the same project/workspace separate?
ui_container_and_type: Request project label span.request-project and sibling request containers in In progress and Waiting
requested_outcome: Explain the grouping rule and evaluate grouping/collapsing related work so project repetition is understandable.
evidence_and_limits: Current renderer groups by explicit request identity; a project can contain several requests, and state sections separate them. Matching project/workspace labels alone do not prove that requests should merge. Examples deliberately share component 04. Preserve the captain’s grouping question for product review; no grouping change is approved by this report.
suggested_owner: Deck information architecture + Firstmate explicit request declarations

title: All repeated metadata needs stable alignment
ui_container_and_type: Whole just-started example request header div.request-head and its div.request-meta
semantic_locator: section.request-row > div.request-head > div.request-meta; title Example: Inspect device folder listing
requested_outcome: Keep the same type of element in the expected position across similar cards, including missing/unknown/long text states.
evidence_and_limits: Broader consistency requirement; retain separately from the bar-only and spend-only comments. Synthetic example content varies, but the request layout comes from the Deck CSS.

title: No progress declared yet: can Firstmate normalize it?
ui_container_and_type: Progress/status text span.prog-txt within div.prog; annotated label No progress declared yet.
requested_outcome: Make progress labels coherent and understandable; establish whether producer declarations need normalization.
evidence_and_limits: Source explicitly distinguishes missing, unknown, stale, invalid and unmeasured progress. Missing data must not be converted into fabricated progress. One example intentionally has no steps; the positional target does not establish that this exact annotation was on the example. Live producer validity remains untested.
suggested_owner: Deck language/state mapping + Firstmate progress evidence owner

title: Provenance and record is agent-oriented clutter
ui_container_and_type: Task detail disclosure details.source-details under div#detail-content; summary Provenance and record
semantic_locator: #detail-content > details.source-details; summary text Provenance and record
requested_outcome: Keep the human task detail focused on useful decisions and outcomes; move technical provenance out of the main reading flow or remove unhelpful fields.
evidence_and_limits: The disclosure is source-rendered by addTechnical. It contains owner/agent/source/date/answer-limit mechanics; the captain requests product content hierarchy changes, not loss of required internal evidence.

title: Malformed-decision description is not useful
ui_container_and_type: Needs you Do/action card article.task-card.card.action-card for [card alias]; title Choose the target branch for upgrade-test tooling
requested_outcome: Present an understandable next action; investigate/fix the underlying unfiled decision record through its owner.
evidence_and_limits: Frozen card action.source is backlog.kind; source bridge.py creates the quoted fallback when a captain-kind item lacks an open structured question. The fallback path is confirmed in source and frozen data, but this report does not prove why that row became incomplete or whether it remains incomplete live.

title: Technical/mechanical wording across action cards

requested_outcome: Rewrite repeated robotic text for humans, including error/recovery language and duplication of title/instruction/context.
evidence_and_limits: This is broader than annotation 11. Frozen card has the same unfiled-decision fallback, so both data repair and human-facing copy are relevant. No copy change is applied by this intake.

title: Inline reply field should be multiline
ui_container_and_type: Question card inline answer composer; div.answer-compose/own-words contains label.answer-label > input[type=text] plus button.answer-send
requested_outcome: Use a multiline answer field with enough visible text to review and edit; define Enter/newline versus explicit Send behavior.
evidence_and_limits: Confirmed source creates input[type=text] in inlineAnswer; full-detail editor separately uses textarea rows=3. Recorded target is the surrounding Send composer, not an input tag. The report identifies the actual input without changing the exact annotation target.

title: Truncated request/title text is unusable
ui_container_and_type: Needs you card metadata; span.req in div.cmeta, showing Approve Jira search guidance for the connector skill and briefs
requested_outcome: Keep useful title/request text readable; a hover title alone should not be the only full-text access.
evidence_and_limits: Source .req uses nowrap/ellipsis and is hidden on narrow screens. The visible card title is a separate .card-open .title element. Do not fix only the wrong title slot.

title: Discuss removal on a report makes no sense
ui_container_and_type: Detail object tools; section.deck-object-tools > section.deck-removal-panel with button.deck-removal-send and attachment composer
requested_outcome: Distinguish report/result review from task-removal actions; make action purpose/context clear and show it only where meaningful.
evidence_and_limits: The source reviewObject helper appends scope-removal consultation controls to task detail, including delivered-result decoration. It asks to discuss removing the work item; it is not proof of a report-delete operation. No removal was clicked or executed.

title: Review cards have excessive unused space

semantic_locator: #board > .attention-list > article.review-card; task task 012 / alias [card alias] (locate by frozen title)

evidence_and_limits: Captain-observed spacing complaint. Inspect card-face, cacts and collapsed card-more/card-more-inner together. No pixel measurement or single CSS cause is established by this intake.

requested_outcome: Remove unjustified space below View result / I have reviewed it and keep equivalent cards consistent.
evidence_and_limits: Retained as a distinct sublocation from annotation 16. Source card structure includes a collapsed detail slot plus cacts; inspect actual layout before assigning cause.

evidence_and_limits: Source moreMenu always adds a title header and Copy item; reviewCard supplies an empty additional-items list. This establishes the observed menu shape, not a completed replacement design.
